name: Plugin bin/ executable on the Bash tool's PATH
description: A file directly under a plugin root's bin/ directory. Claude Code adds bin/ to the Bash tool's PATH while the plugin is enabled, so the file is invokable as a BARE COMMAND in any Bash tool call: no markdown reference, no skill invocation, and no permission prompt naming the file's path is required. This is a strictly stronger surface than claude.payload.bundled-script (target bundledPayload), which covers .claude/skills and .claude/commands payloads reachable only through their owning markdown. executable is surfaced as a field, never used as a gate: the +x bit is trivially settable, is absent on Windows checkouts, and gating on it would let a chmod hide the surface.
message: Plugin bin/ file is invokable as a bare command on the Bash tool's PATH
